# Commands sub-actions

## Get command group state

Checks a group of chat commands and tells you if all, none or some are turned on. Command groups are made on the Commands page.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Command group** | The command group's name from the Commands page. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%commandGroupState%` | 0 = all are off, 1 = all are on, 2 = some on and some off |
| `%commandGroupEnabled%` | True if the group has commands and all are on |
| `%commandGroupCount%` | How many commands are in the group |

<small>Type id: `commands.getGroupState`</small>

## Get command state

Checks if one chat command is turned on, and how many times it has been used. Pair it with an If step to react.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Command** | The command's name from the Commands page. The default %commandName% is the command that started this action. Starts as: `%commandName%`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%commandEnabled%` | True if the command is on |
| `%commandStateName%` | The command's name |
| `%commandCounter%` | How many times the command has been used |

<small>Type id: `commands.getState`</small>

## Get commands

Makes a ready list of your chat commands as text, like "!hello, !discord, !uptime". Good for a !commands reply.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Store in argument** | The start of the variable names, without % signs. The default commands gives %commands% (the text), %commandsList% and %commandsCount%. Starts as: `commands`. |
| **Only this group** | Only list commands of this command group. Empty or All = every group. |
| **List** | First alias = each command's first name. All aliases = every name a command answers to. Names = the name you gave it. Options: First alias, All aliases, Names. Starts as: `First alias`. |
| **Separator** | What goes between the commands, like a comma and a space. Starts as: `, `. |
| **Include disabled commands** | Tick to also list commands that are turned off. Starts as: `false`. |
| **Include all (ignore each command's Include option)** | Tick to also list commands that are set to be left out of the list. Starts as: `false`. |
| **Only commands the user may use** | Tick to list only the commands the viewer who started the action is allowed to use. Starts as: `false`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%commands%` | The commands as one line of text (the variable name can be changed in the settings) |
| `%commandsCount%` | How many commands were listed |

<small>Type id: `commands.getCommands`</small>

## Reset command counters

Sets a command's use counter back to zero, and/or the counters of single viewers. Useful for a "counter" command you want to restart.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Command** | The command's name from the Commands page. The default %commandName% is the command that started this action. Starts as: `%commandName%`. |
| **Reset** | Counter = the total count. User counters = the counts of single viewers. Both = both. Options: Counter, User counters, Both. Starts as: `Counter`. |
| **User's platform** | The site of the viewer, when you reset just one viewer. The default %platform% is whoever started the action. Starts as: `%platform%`. |
| **Only this user id** | The id of the one viewer to reset. Empty = reset every viewer's counter. |

<small>Type id: `commands.resetCounters`</small>

## Set command group state

Turns all chat commands of a command group on or off, or flips them. Good for switching a whole set at once, like game commands.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Command group** | The command group's name from the Commands page. |
| **State** | Enable turns them on. Disable turns them off. Toggle turns all on unless they already are, then turns them off. Options: Enable, Disable, Toggle. Starts as: `Enable`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%commandGroupCount%` | How many commands were changed |

<small>Type id: `commands.setGroupState`</small>

## Set command state

Turns one chat command on or off, or flips it. Good for a command that should only work during part of the stream.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Command** | The command's name from the Commands page. The default %commandName% is the command that started this action. Starts as: `%commandName%`. |
| **State** | Enable turns it on. Disable turns it off. Toggle switches it to the opposite. Options: Enable, Disable, Toggle. Starts as: `Enable`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%commandEnabled%` | True if the command is on now |

<small>Type id: `commands.setState`</small>
